europe_now.title: Spain imposes border checks on Italian travellers amid migrant dispute
europe_now.summary: Spain has implemented border checks on Italian travelers in response to a migrant row, reflecting heightened cross-border tensions. The measure aims to address security and migration concerns between the two EU nations.

sources.headline: Spain imposes border checks on Italian travellers amid migrant dispute

europe_now.title: Russian missile strikes kill three near Kyiv, Zelensky makes landmark visit to Serbia
europe_now.summary: Russian attacks near Kyiv resulted in three fatalities, while Ukraine's Zelenskyy visited Serbia, a Russia-friendly country, signaling diplomatic complexities. The events highlight ongoing security threats and shifting geopolitical dynamics in Europe.

sources.headline: Russian strikes kill three near Kyiv, Zelensky makes landmark visit to Serbia

top_stories.title: Ceuta border crisis between Spain and Italy
top_stories.summary: Spain's border checks on Italy stem from a migrant dispute, creating friction between EU neighbors. The situation underscores challenges in managing cross-border security and migration policies.

sources.headline: Spain imposes border checks on Italian travellers amid migrant dispute

top_stories.title: Ukraine-Russia conflict escalation and diplomatic shifts
top_stories.summary: Recent missile strikes in Ukraine and Zelenskyy's visit to Serbia illustrate the conflict's persistence and diplomatic maneuvering. These developments reflect broader security and political uncertainties in the region.

sources.headline: Russian strikes kill three near Kyiv, Zelensky makes landmark visit to Serbia
